method: Three deterministic ordering/storage-failure/barrier regressions run against current production module, then the exact frozen c165 production module loaded from Git in memory; no sleep-based race or disk-source replacement.
scope: Synthetic regression verification of the working-tree patch before its release freeze. This is not final source CI, a package build, a platform-page test, or a publication receipt. The exact frozen baseline was loaded from Git in memory; on-disk production source was not replaced.

deterministic_regressions.name: test_specific_failure_diagnostic_precedes_error_and_terminal_publication
deterministic_regressions.property: The diagnostic callback sees no published worker_error, worker_done or terminal event; explicit sdk_setup metadata exists first. Assertions are outside the exception-swallowing callback.

deterministic_regressions.name: test_diagnostic_storage_failure_still_publishes_tool_error_without_retry
deterministic_regressions.property: A diagnostic storage OSError cannot suppress the error or initiate another tool/RPC. The callback still precedes publication.

deterministic_regressions.name: test_paused_failure_diagnostic_cannot_expose_error_or_terminal_before_specific_phase
deterministic_regressions.property: An Event barrier pauses the diagnostic callback while another thread observes no prematurely published failure/terminal flag; final view preserves sdk_setup and missing_browser_service.

freeze_binding.scope: Added after the freeze; the original 97-case working-tree run and exact c165 baseline provenance above remain unchanged. This binds tested patch bytes to the new immutable commit, not a rerun of those tests.
